meta.name: ACM
meta.author: AttaraX
meta.description:
Mindustry? Yes, but Cheats! 

This mod fills 'nearly every crafting block with the items and liquids it requires even the Modded Blocks.

It has a UI that appears on the top-left side of the game, which allows you to choose the amount of items per second that are filled and on which teams you want this cheat to work.'
